project.title: Metagenomics of pilot-scale algal-bacterial  photobioreactor for simultaneous CH4 and CO2  removal from digestate
project.description: Shotgun metagenomic sequencing of microbial communities from a pilot-scale algal-bacterial photobioreactor system treating real digestate across four operational stages: startup (full illumination, HRT=1d, Sample 1), stable stage I (full illumination, HRT=2d, Sample 2), stable stage II (full illumination, HRT=1.6d, Sample 3), and light-dark alternation stage (12h light/dark, HRT=1.6d, Sample 4).
